trigger: The promised 2026-09-04 18:00 UTC publication deadline has passed for the USD1 fourth and final completed distribution and the RLUSD third completed distribution.

frozen_extraction.common: Decode the retained CMS response as JSON, require data.title and data.body, decode data.body as a JSON document tree, flatten text nodes inside the first table in document order, and normalize whitespace.
frozen_extraction.placeholder_rule: If the scheduled row still contains 'To be updated on 2026-09-04', or the exact regex does not match, retain the response and fail closed without retrying an alias, locale, article, or parameter.

frozen_calculations.usd1_simple_earn_fixed_bonus_comparison: 7.00 percent minus final USD1 base APR; historical only because the holding campaign has ended
frozen_calculations.forward_reward_floor: zero for the ended USD1 campaign and zero for the unpublished RLUSD fourth week

decision_rules: Completed-period rates are historical recurrence evidence, never a guaranteed forward rate.
Do not accept RLUSD unless account eligibility, independently genuine pre-existing qualifying volume, acquisition and exit costs, opportunity cost, and owned reward realization are proved.
Do not treat an ended USD1 holding campaign as currently deployable; preserve only the historical scoped acceptance and the still-live Simple Earn candidate under its existing account and cost gates.
Do not use, inspect, serialize, or require credentials for these public unauthenticated sources.
Do not place orders, subscribe, redeem, convert, transfer, or mutate an account.
